elements.name: Authentication Module
elements.description: Handles user authentication and session management.

elements.name: Backend Module
elements.description: Backend-Modul für die Bearbeitung des Graphen.

elements.name: Frontend Module
elements.description: Frontend-Modul für die Anzeige und Bearbeitung des Graphen.

elements.name: Authentication Requirement
elements.description: Nutzer müssen sich authentifizieren, um auf die Web-App zuzugreifen.

elements.name: Authentication Concrete
elements.description: The system shall authenticate users within 1 second with a success rate of >= 95% under load.

elements.name: Authentication Measurable
elements.description: Authentication must succeed within 1 second for 95% of requests under load.

elements.name: Export Formats Requirement
elements.description: Nutzer können den Graphenstand als JSON oder Format-E exportieren.

elements.name: Export Formats Concrete
elements.description: The system shall export the governed graph in JSON, XML, and CSV formats with validation success rate >= 98%.

elements.name: Export Formats Measurable
elements.description: Export formats must support JSON, XML, and CSV with validation success rate >= 98%.

elements.name: Live Updates Requirement
elements.description: Nutzer sehen Live-Updates des Graphen.

elements.name: Live Updates Concrete
elements.description: The system shall reflect live updates to all connected clients within 500ms.

elements.name: Live Updates Measurable
elements.description: Live updates must reflect changes within 500ms for all connected clients.

elements.name: Web-App
elements.description: Multiuser-fähige Web-App für die Bearbeitung des governten Systemgraphen.

elements.name: Verify Authentication
elements.description: Test verifies that users can authenticate successfully within 1 second under load conditions. Uses a load testing tool to simulate 100 concurrent users and measures authentication success rate >= 95%.

elements.name: Verify Authentication Concrete
elements.description: Test verifies that the system authenticates users within 1 second with a success rate of >= 95% under load. Uses a load testing tool to simulate high traffic and measures response times.

elements.name: Verify Authentication Measurable
elements.description: Test verifies that authentication succeeds within 1 second for 95% of requests under load. Uses a load testing tool to simulate high traffic and measures response times.

elements.name: Verify Export Formats
elements.description: Test verifies that the system exports the graph in JSON, XML, and CSV formats with a validation success rate >= 98%. Uses schema validation tools to ensure exported data adheres to the expected format.

elements.name: Verify Export Formats Concrete
elements.description: Test verifies that the system exports the governed graph in JSON, XML, and CSV formats with a validation success rate >= 98%. Uses schema validation tools to ensure exported data adheres to the expected format.

elements.name: Verify Export Formats Measurable
elements.description: Test verifies that export formats support JSON, XML, and CSV with a validation success rate >= 98%. Uses schema validation tools to ensure exported data adheres to the expected format.

elements.name: Verify Live Updates
elements.description: Test that live updates are reflected within 500ms for all connected clients.

elements.name: Verify Live Updates Concrete
elements.description: Test that live updates are reflected within 500ms for all connected clients with a success rate of >= 98%.

elements.name: Verify Live Updates Measurable
elements.description: Test that live updates are reflected within 500ms for all connected clients with a success rate of >= 98%.

elements.name: Graph bearbeiten
elements.description: Nutzer fügt Knoten/Kanten hinzu, löscht oder aktualisiert Elemente und sieht Live-Updates.

elements.name: Exportieren
elements.description: Nutzer exportiert den aktuellen Graphenstand als JSON/Format-E.

elements.name: Login
elements.description: Nutzer meldet sich mit Benutzername/Passwort an und erhält eine Session.
